title: Silver Key

[[Image:SilverKey.png|right|160px]]
'''Silver Key''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Put 1 [[Stamina token]] from the bank on Silver Key before making an [[Evade check]] to automatically pass it.  Discard Silver Key after using it if there are 3 [[Stamina token]]s on it.

'''Price''': $4

==Mythos Source==
The Silver Key first appears in the story ''The Silver Key'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1926).
